result.description: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) lets sellers and vendors programmatically manage orders, listings, catalog, inventory, fulfillment, reports and finances on Amazon marketplaces.
result.auth_detail: Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2 authorization-code flow. The seller authorizes the app and the app gets a long-lived refresh token, then exchanges it for a 1-hour LWA access token. Private apps self-authorize with up to 10 refresh tokens. Restricted operations use grantless or restricted data tokens. The seller must reauthorize every 365 days.
result.access_detail: Developer must register a developer profile with Amazon. A private app for your own seller account can be self-authorized with no listing. Public apps that other sellers connect need Amazon review and approval (app listing, and extra review for restricted roles such as PII). A seller or vendor account is required. Verified only from search snippets and the GitHub repo, because the docs host redirected to a malformed domain and could not be fetched. Access confidence is medium to low.
result.api_notes: REST APIs by region. They cover Orders, Catalog Items, Listings, Feeds, Reports, FBA Inventory, Finances, Fulfillment Inbound/Outbound, Notifications, Product Pricing, Data Kiosk (GraphQL queries) and Vendor APIs. Amazon's sample repo describes 304 operations across 40+ services.
result.blocker: Multi-tenant use needs a public SP-API app approved by Amazon (developer registration, app review, restricted-role review). Sellers must reauthorize every 365 days. Private-app self-authorization works for a single seller account. The Amazon MCP is sample code, not a supported product.

evidence.quote: This process generates an LWA refresh token with a maximum of 10 authorizations per application.
A Login with Amazon (LWA) access token authorizes your application to take certain actions on behalf of a selling partner.
Before doing this you must register as a developer and register your application.
The selling partner must reauthorize your application every 365 days, and your application must store the new refresh token that the reauthorization returns.
This repository contains sample solutions, developer tools (including MCP servers and a local sandbox), and code recipes for the Selling Partner API.
A local MCP server for SP-API that bundles multiple developer tools into a single npm package.
